Zoe (CSM): Heads-up: Tidewell reserved pool go-live TOMORROW 09:00 PT. Need final quota plan, autoscale thresholds, and a 30m load test window. Can we confirm?
Marcus (SRE): Provisioning done today. Pool = 6xA10G slices. Can scale to 8 if needed.
Anya (Onboarding): Onboarding checklist mostly green. KMS + network ACL approvals complete. Renewal flagged medium risk until latency stabilizes.
Ravi (EngInfra): Default autoscaler: scale_up at 70% GPU util over 60s, scale_down at 30% over 5m. For short bursts recommend faster scale_up and a burst buffer.
Kira (Solutions): Suggest scale_up at 60% (45s cooldown), burst_reserve +2 nodes, pre-warm KV caches for first 2m, fallback to quant-8 model if queue >75.
Marcus (SRE): Agreed on pre-warm. Router queue threshold = 40 to trigger burst. Add soft per-customer token rate limit.
Zoe (CSM): Tidewell expects 200 qps peak, 30 qps sustained. If we meet that, renewal addendum likely to go through. Anya, add to success criteria.
Anya (Onboarding): Done: "SLA: p95 < 450ms short gen, throughput 200 qps peak, token cost within estimate." Adding KMS/network sign-offs.
Kira (Solutions): I'll run the shadow load at 09:15 PT for 30m. Script (ramp 5m, 20m steady, 5m cooldown):
```bash
hey -n 360000 -c 200 "https://staging.redwood.example/v1/generate" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -m POST -d '{"model":"tidewell-prod-v1","input":"short prompt"}'
```
Kira (Solutions): Will upload metrics to console after run.
deploy-bot: pool.tidewell-reserved status=READY nodes=6 zone=us-west-2a
deploy-bot: autoscaler.policy="util-60s" current_reserve=0 burst_buffer=2
Zoe (CSM): Two asks: 1) Someone join customer debrief at 10:30 PT, 2) Tag regressions as "renewal-risk" if response time >3x.
Marcus (SRE): I'll join 10:30 and set an alert: p95 latency > 1.5s for 3m -> page oncall. Starting final smoke.
Kira (Solutions): Ramp 5m looks good. Queues <10, autoscaler idle.
Marcus (SRE): Minute 12 queue hit 48, autoscaler +2 nodes, p95 back to ~430ms. No errors.
Anya (Onboarding): Customer on call says responses feel snappy. They're watching cost estimates but happier about latency.
Zoe (CSM): I'll mark renewal status as "monitoring" and update after 24h if stable. Marketing will want a quote if clean.
Kira (Solutions): Test artifacts -> https://console.redwood.example/projects/tidewell/tests/1708888001
Marcus (SRE): Final note: enabled KV prefix caching for first 100 tokens, configured quantized fallback in router mapping. Will post detailed metrics in ~5m.
Zoe (CSM): Thanks team!"
